items.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
items.summary: Sweden's Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.

items.title: Mastercard brings stablecoin balances into traditional banking and card payments

items.title: Russia to ban direct peer-to-peer crypto trades starting July 2027

items.title: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
